title: ‘Bigger than internet’: Trump officially renames AI as ‘super intelligence’
content: US President Donald Trump has officially signed an executive order that replaces the term 'Artificial Intelligence' with 'Super Intelligence.' This shift mandates federal agencies to update their communications accordingly, showcasing the evolving technological landscape. At a White House gathering with tech executives, Trump emphasized this pivotal change, with a new legal definition expected to be proposed to Congress in the near future.

title: India's League of Legends team returns to Asiad with Hangzhou lessons
content: Akshaj Shenoy returns to the Asian Games as captain of India's League of Legends team, three years after the side finished fifth in Hangzhou. Four players from that campaign return, joined by two Asian Games debutants. The group has since won in South Asia, competed against stronger regional opposition and joined S8UL. Now, against South Korea, Chinese Taipei and Hong Kong, they want to compete, not simply learn.

title: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan donate $4 million to save 600-year-old Hawaii fishpond
content: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have contributed $4 million for the preservation of Alakoko Fishpond in Hawaii. This historic site, which is over 600 years old, faced potential environmental degradation and development pressure. The donation helped acquire the property for long-term stewardship by the nonprofit Mālama Hulē‘ia. Their initiative supports education about traditional Hawaiian aquaculture and native ecosystems.

title: Nevada volunteers remove 120,125 pounds of waste from Truckee River watershed
content: On September 26, over 575 passionate volunteers dedicated their time to a significant cleanup effort in Nevada's Truckee River watershed. Their hard work resulted in the removal of an astounding 120,125 pounds of waste, which included both litter and invasive weeds. This collaborative initiative also focused on planting vegetation and enhancing storm drains, all aimed at safeguarding the local ecosystem.

title: INDIA bloc to meet today to finalise plan for anti-SIR agitation
content: The INDIA bloc's opposition members are set to meet to formulate a plan of action against the Election Commission, centering on the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Notable leaders from Congress and TMC will attend, while DMK and AAP will be absent. This meeting follows a recent protest by Left party members at the EC headquarters demanding Kumar's resignation.

title: Essex family left 50 farm acres wild; it inspired 200-acre nature recovery plan
content: Braxted Park Estate has initiated a 200-acre biodiversity recovery project following ten years of observation on 50 acres. This approach aims to enhance local ecological conditions and meet developers' biodiversity obligations. Property developers can purchase biodiversity units through the estate's habitat bank to comply with legal requirements. A long-term management agreement ensures the land will be protected and monitored for 30 years.

title: Orlando Bravo paid $39.25m for Phil Collins’ Miami mansion, then demolished it
content: Orlando Bravo has received approval to tear down a historic estate in Miami Beach that was once the home of Phil Collins. This demolition paves the way for a new luxury mansion, purposefully designed to combat flooding. The choice has ignited discussions about the importance of preserving historical sites in South Florida, with many advocates worried about the potential loss of early 20th-century architecture as climate challenges mount.

title: Not just CEC, PM Modi and Shah should also resign for 'vote chori', says CWC
content: The Congress Working Committee has called for the resignations of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Amit Shah. Rahul Gandhi highlighted concerns about electoral roll integrity and alleged vote manipulation during elections. The CWC meeting also emphasized the urgency of restoring deleted voter registrations. Members discussed the necessity of organizing public agitation to raise awareness about electoral issues.

title: Roger Federer’s $550M fortune: How did tennis greatness build his empire?
content: Roger Federer's financial story is a case study in how elite sporting success can translate into a long-term commercial career. His Uniqlo deal provided large guaranteed income, while his On investment gave him significant equity exposure. These ventures, along with Rolex, Mercedes-Benz, TEAM8 and the Laver Cup, helped Federer build a fortune that goes way beyond tennis.

title: 18 warships to be inducted in 2026, largest addition in a year in Navy’s history: Rajnath

He unveiled plans for essential upgrades and the arrival of new warships aimed at enhancing maritime surveillance. Singh lauded the Navy's commitment to protecting vital sea lanes that are crucial for India's economy and energy needs, while also recognizing its significant contributions towards women's empowerment and regional security.

title: Fort Kochi’s 300-year-old Koder House completely gutted in fire
content: Koder House, a significant heritage structure in Fort Kochi, suffered complete destruction due to a fire. This building, dating back to 1800s, was connected to the influential Koder family in the local Jewish community. Previously, it functioned as a boutique hotel and hosted cultural events related to Judaism. The incident has highlighted the urgent need for preserving historic buildings in the area.

title: Trade irony amid Trump threat: Why Russia is buying its own oil as fuel from India
content: The underlying issue is not Russia's access to crude oil but its ability to convert crude into usable fuels.  Refinery outages and infrastructure disruptions have constrained domestic production, forcing Russia to import products such as gasoline. In terms of magnitude, Russia’s import volume of oil products is not colossal. However, Russia, formerly the world’s largest oil-product exporter, now faces additional logistical costs

title: US to lend 40m barrel oil from strategic reserve as Ukraine war strains supply

This initiative is designed to counteract rising oil prices, which have been significantly impacted by the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran. As Indian refiners brace for a decline in Russian oil supplies, competition with China is pushing them toward pricier oil options.

Erdogan suggested dialogue to resolve disputes, including the Kashmir issue, within the United Nations framework. India has consistently maintained that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of the nation.

title: Essex farm flooded with seawater helped double saltmarsh across Thames estuary

Marine life flourished, and biodiversity increased rapidly in the newly flooded areas after the breach. Traditional farming on higher land continued alongside saltmarsh restoration, contributing to sustainable agriculture.

title: On cam: Military aircraft crashes in Russia due to 'fuel explosion'; 6 dead
content:
Russian defence ministry Tu-154 crashes in Amur region

A Russian ministry aircraft crashed near the village of Krasnoyanovo in the Amur region on Tuesday, killing six people, according several local media reports. Seven people were reportedly on board the Tu-154 aircraft, with one survivor sustaining injuries and being hospitalised. Preliminary information suggested the crash may have been caused by a "fuel explosion" on board. A large fire broke out at the crash site following the incident. Several videos of the aircraft after the crash was circulated on social media. An investigation into the cause of the crash is underway.

title: Mehul Choksi drops damages claim against government, Hungarian woman in London HC
content: mehul Choksi dropped a multi-million-pound damages claim against the four male defendants . he allegedly kidnapped him in antigua in a honeytrap plot on may 23, 2021 . the 67-year-old alleged at the HC that the govt conspired with five individuals to unlawfully kidnap, torture and extrajudicially render him .

title: Budgam encounter: Army kills LeT terrorist in fierce gunfight in Yousmarg
content: the army, jammu and Kashmir police and CRPF Srinagar were searching the general area of Korag when troops noticed suspicious activity . the encounter took place in the higher reaches of central Kashmir’s Budgam district .

title: India warns US about cosying up to Pakistan, says could impact ties
content: external affairs minister warns that a lack of understanding will affect bilateral ties . terrorism is of particular importance to India, he says, without naming Pakistan . india and the us had announced the finalisation of the framework for the first phase of the bilateral trade agreement .

title: CISF jawan kills 4 colleagues at Kathua hydel plant
content: four CISF personnel, including an assistant commandant, were killed on tuesday . head constable abhidesh Kumar allegedly started shooting from his service rifle following an argument with some colleagues . the exact circumstances and the nature of the altercation that led to the fatal firing at the site in Mashka village remain unclear .
